category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.rationale: The packet does not target sensitive, itchy, dry-feeling, oily or dandruff scalp; the supported production route is the ordinary balanced shampoo bucket.

category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.cle.rationale: Moderate: SLES at position 2 gives effective ordinary cleansing, but CAPB, later coco-glucoside and early peptide/cationic-care signals prevent a strong-reset classification. Observed intensity: regular.

product.suitable_thicknesses.rationale: Ideal: normal — Moderate cleansing, high repair conditioning and moderate weight fit normal split-end-prone hair. coarse — Coarse hair benefits from the high care system while the moderate weight remains acceptable. Conditional (not emitted): fine — High conditioning plus peptide/cationic/refatting routes can reduce lift on fine hair, even without silicone.

required_protocol_roles.rationale: Roles derived from reviewed buckets: shampoo_everyday.

research.properties.cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: SLES at position 2 gives effective ordinary cleansing, but CAPB, later coco-glucoside and early peptide/cationic-care signals prevent a strong-reset classification.

research.properties.conditioningLevel.rationale: High: pea peptide at position 5, cationic guar at position 6 and several lipid/refatting/waxy routes create a substantial rinse-off care system for split-end/damage positioning.

research.properties.dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: the complete canonical formula contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.

research.properties.focusPrimary.rationale: Repair: revealed claims center on split-end and damaged-hair sealing, and the formula has a compatible early peptide, cationic polymer and refatting care architecture.

research.properties.focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: split-end sealing and damaged-hair claims are one repair story, with no distinct secondary volume, shine, clarifying or scalp-active route.

research.properties.scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: the product is positioned for hair-fiber damage and split-end sealing, not sensitive, itchy, dry-feeling or uncomfortable scalp.

research.properties.usageRole.rationale: Regular: directions are standard wet-hair distribution and rinse-out use; regular application wording confirms ordinary recurring use rather than treatment or reset usage.

research.properties.weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: early cationic guar plus peptide, glyceryl oleate and hydrogenated castor oil can leave residue, but SLES/CAPB cleansing, no silicone and no-weight positioning keep this below high.
